issues.t: Alternator can short internally and overheat (recall)
issues.sym: The battery light may come on, the lights may dim, or you may notice a hot electrical smell from under the hood.
issues.why: A diode inside the alternator can be damaged and short out, which can melt the alternator housing and start a fire.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the open recall and have the alternator replaced before driving further if you notice a burning smell or a charging light.

issues.t: Ignition coils fail and cause misfires
issues.sym: The engine shakes at idle, hesitates when you accelerate, and the check engine light comes on or flashes.
issues.why: Each cylinder has its own ignition coil, and on these years the coils tend to break down with heat and age, often several around the same time.
issues.next: Have the misfire codes read soon. If the check engine light flashes, pull over when it's safe and turn the engine off.

issues.t: Front lower control arm pin can break at the frame (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk from the front end, a wheel that looks out of position, or sudden trouble steering.
issues.why: The pin that attaches the front transverse link to the frame can crack and snap, letting the front wheel shift.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall. If you hear a sudden front-end clunk or the steering changes, stop driving and have it towed.

issues.t: Gas pedal can travel too far and limit engine speed (recall)
issues.sym: After pressing the pedal hard to the floor, the engine may suddenly refuse to rev and the car barely accelerates.
issues.why: The pedal stopper lets the pedal move past its intended range, and the electronic throttle system reacts by cutting engine speed.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and have the updated pedal stopper fitted. Avoid flooring the pedal until it is done.

issues.t: Crank or cam position sensor can cut out and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The engine stalls without warning, cranks a long time before starting, or the check engine light comes on.
issues.why: A weak solder joint on the circuit board inside the crankshaft or camshaft position sensor can open up, and the engine computer loses its timing signal.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and have the sensors replaced promptly, because a stall in traffic is a safety risk.

issues.t: Glass roof panel can shatter (recall)
issues.sym: A loud bang followed by broken glass from the fixed glass roof panel, sometimes with no impact.
issues.why: Some Skyview roof glass panels were not tempered correctly at the factory and can break on their own.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and have the roof glass inspected. If it has cracked, cover it and get it replaced soon.

issues.t: Driver seat wiring can short and start a fire (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell or smoke from under the driver seat, or the power lumbar support stops working.
issues.why: The lumbar switch wiring under the driver seat can get pinched by the seat frame, rub through, and short out.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall. If you smell burning from the seat, stop using the car and have it repaired right away.

issues.t: Automatic transmission shifts harshly or slips
issues.sym: Hard, jerky shifts, a bang when it downshifts as you slow, or the engine revving without the car picking up speed.
issues.why: Owners of the conventional automatic used in these years report early wear and valve body problems that upset shift quality.
issues.next: Have the transmission fluid condition and any stored codes checked soon. Catching it early can sometimes avoid a full rebuild.

issues.t: Timing chain guides and tensioner wear and whine
issues.sym: A high-pitched whine or rattle from the front of the engine that rises with engine speed, sometimes with a check engine light.
issues.why: The secondary timing chain guides and tensioners wear, letting the chains run loose and noisy.
issues.next: Have the noise diagnosed soon. A badly worn chain system can jump timing and cause serious engine damage.

issues.t: Rear subframe bracket can crack (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking from the rear, the back of the car feeling loose or wandering, or uneven rear tire wear.
issues.why: Some rear subframes were made with a defect that lets a bracket holding the rear suspension crack.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall. If the rear end feels loose or clunks, stop driving and have the subframe inspected.

issues.t: Steering column can lock while the car is moving (recall)
issues.sym: On cars with the Intelligent Key, the steering wheel can lock when turned to the right while the shifter is out of Park.
issues.why: The electronic steering lock assembly can engage when it should not.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and have the steering lock assembly replaced before relying on the car.

issues.t: Front strut mounts can crack (recall)
issues.sym: A knocking or popping noise from the front over bumps, or steering that suddenly feels off.
issues.why: The rubber and metal insulators at the top of the front struts can crack, letting the strut rod move out of position.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall. If you hear front-end knocking, have it inspected right away and avoid driving until it is checked.

issues.t: Electronic steering lock fails and the car will not start
issues.sym: You press the start button and nothing happens, often with a key warning light, and the steering wheel stays locked.
issues.why: The electronic steering column lock unit sticks and the car will not allow the engine to start until it releases.
issues.next: It will not harm the car but can leave you stranded. Have a shop confirm the steering lock is the cause before replacing the starter or battery.

issues.t: Front brake caliper bolts may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk or rattle from a front wheel when braking, or a brake that suddenly feels wrong.
issues.why: Some front brake caliper mounting bolts were not tightened fully at the factory.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and have the bolts checked before driving further if you hear a front brake clunk.

issues.t: Fuel tank seal may leak in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: Usually nothing day to day; some owners notice a fuel smell near the rear seat.
issues.why: The O-ring on the fuel sending unit at the top of the tank may not be seated properly and could let fuel escape in a collision.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and have the retainer ring installed. Have any fuel smell checked soon.

issues.t: ABS unit seal can fail and reduce brake pressure (recall)
issues.sym: A brake warning light, a low or soft brake pedal, or longer stopping distances.
issues.why: An O-ring inside the ABS actuator may have been damaged during assembly, which can let brake pressure drop.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall. If the pedal feels soft or a brake warning is on, stop driving and have it towed in.

issues.t: Forward emergency braking warning from the front radar sensor
issues.sym: A warning that front radar or forward emergency braking is unavailable, even in clear weather.
issues.why: The radar sensor behind the front bumper can be knocked out of alignment or blocked; Nissan issued a service bulletin on diagnosing it.
issues.next: Keep the bumper area clean and have the sensor alignment and bracket checked at your next visit. Drive without relying on automatic braking until then.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may be switched off by mistake (recall)
issues.sym: The passenger airbag off light shows with an adult in the front seat, or the airbag warning light stays on.
issues.why: The seat sensing system can misjudge who is sitting in the front passenger seat and disable that airbag.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recalls and have the software updated soon. Until then, seat adults in the rear if the off light is showing.

issues.t: ABS unit can leak brake fluid inside and catch fire (recall)
issues.sym: The ABS warning light stays on after start-up. In rare cases there is a burning smell or smoke from under the hood, even when parked.
issues.why: A seal in the ABS actuator can let brake fluid seep onto its circuit board, causing an electrical short.
issues.next: If the ABS light stays on, park outside away from buildings, do not drive, and have the dealer replace the actuator under the recall.

issues.t: CVT shudders or vibrates
issues.sym: A shake or judder when accelerating gently, sometimes with a check engine light.
issues.why: Wear in the CVT valve body or the chain and pulley assembly; Nissan released a service bulletin covering the diagnosis and repair.
issues.next: Have it checked soon and ask the dealer about the CVT judder bulletin. Continuing to drive with heavy judder can turn a smaller repair into a full replacement.

issues.t: Ticking or popping from behind the rear seat
issues.sym: A ticking, tapping, or popping sound from the rear seatback area over bumps.
issues.why: Two body panels behind the rear seat sit close enough to touch and rub; Nissan has a service bulletin with a fix.
issues.next: It is an annoyance rather than a safety problem. Mention the bulletin at your next service visit.

issues.t: Backup camera image can be hidden by a saved setting (recall)
issues.sym: The rear view picture does not appear, or is too dark to see, when you shift into Reverse.
issues.why: Display settings can be changed so the camera image is not visible, and the setting stays that way on the next start.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and have the camera software updated. Use mirrors and look behind you in the meantime.

issues.t: Rear window glass may not be bonded properly (recall)
issues.sym: Wind noise or a water leak around the rear window, or glass that looks loose.
issues.why: The rear glass may not have been secured to the body correctly and could come loose.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and have the rear glass replaced soon.

issues.t: Aftermarket corner lamps may be missing a side reflector (recall)
issues.sym: Nothing changes in the way the car drives, but if the front corner or combination lamps have ever been replaced with aftermarket parts, the car may have no amber reflector on the side of the lamp.
issues.why: Several lamp makers sold replacement corner, combination and head lamps for these Maximas without the amber side reflector that federal rules require, so the car is harder for other drivers to pick out from the side at night.
issues.next: Monitor it. Have a shop confirm the lamps fitted to the car are compliant units; the lamp maker replaces the recalled ones at no charge.
